item.title: Instagram Plant Shop Announcement

turns.text: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text.

item.tests: Checks that Instagram feed context leads to a square or 4:5 image without requiring the user to specify dimensions.

answer_sheet.Platform and dimensions: Instagram feed; either square or 4:5 portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Bring home some green” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Visual content and style: Lots of lush potted houseplants on a clean cream background.

must_haves: One finished image has either a 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, not landscape or 9:16.
The headline reads exactly “Bring home some green”.
Multiple lush potted houseplants are clearly visible against a cream background.
The headline is readable at feed-viewing size, with no clipped letters.

turns.text: make a post for a little houseplant shop
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the graphic because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits, but here’s a ready-to-use post:

🌿 **A little green goes a long way.**

A sunny windowsill, a cozy corner, a new leafy friend. Stop by our little houseplant shop and find a plant to make your space feel more like you. 🪴

What’s on your plant wish list?

#HouseplantShop #PlantLove #IndoorJungle #ShopSmall

**Visual idea:** Potted plants on a wooden shelf, warm sunlight, and cream-and-sage colors. Overlay: “A little green goes a long way.”

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a charming square Instagram promotional post for a small independent houseplant shop. Warm editorial illustration with softly textured cream paper background, sage green and terracotta palette, beautiful lush potted monstera, pothos and small leafy houseplants arranged on a cozy wooden shelf. Friendly neighborhood shop atmosphere, natural sunlight, stylish uncluttered layout with generous breathing room. Prominent beautifully legible headline exactly: "A little green goes a long way." Smaller supporting text exactly: "Find your new leafy friend". No shop name, no invented address, no discounts, no logos, no additional text. Polished boutique social media graphic.
